feature_on.command: cargo test -p rsnano_node -p rsnano_messages -p rsnano_types --features rsnano_node/rai_protocol --lib --quiet

regressions: new responses do not overtake queued evidence
failed batches do not move the replay cursor
oversized messages cannot enter the proof store
independent four-replica recovery from a lost response round using one-response retry batches
limitations: Accounting uses local serde JSON, not the eventual wire envelope
Current request, decision proof, fresh effects and fetches are outside the historical-response replay budget
Total retained evidence and pending-work bounds remain unimplemented
No round synchronizer, retry timer, outer fast/slow node service or Gate B completion
